definitions.gloss: the authorities, the relevant agency, the bureau
definitions.explanation: The government body or officials responsible for a particular matter. Used to refer to regulatory, law enforcement, or administrative authorities without specifying the exact organization.

examples.japanese: {当局|とうきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}した→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧。
⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{当局|とうきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The financial authorities announced new regulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{当局|とうきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}→避難勧告：16642_hinankankoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}めている→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: Local authorities issued an evacuation advisory to residents and are working to prevent the damage from spreading.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used primarily in news reporting and official contexts. Often preceded by a modifier specifying the field of responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧{当局|とうきょく}: investigative authorities
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{当局|とうきょく}: financial authorities
- ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧{当局|とうきょく}: regulatory authorities
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{当局|とうきょく}: local authorities
- {当局者|とうきょくしゃ}: an official, an authority figure
